annotations.title: Fetch one search result in full

description: PURPOSE: Read one item in full by an id that search (or another tool) returned: a verse (KJV text), a need's verse set, a church, a gathering (with whether it has passed), a community, or an lb: denomination, saint, sacred site, biblical figure, Bible place or directory church. WHEN TO USE: right after search, with an id exactly as returned (the ChatGPT connector contract). WHEN NOT: other lb: URNs (gatherings, ministries, needs, testimonies, profiles): search (mode protocol). A reference you already know: read_scripture. PARAMETERS: id, passed unchanged: verse:<ref>, need:<slug>, church:<uuid>, gathering:<uuid>, community:<uuid>, or lb:<kind>:<slug>. The prefix before the first colon picks the source. OUTPUT: id, title, text (Scripture verbatim), url, and metadata (kind-specific facts plus attribution; unresolved holds the id when it was not found). BEHAVIOR: read only. An id that cannot be resolved returns a normal result with metadata.unresolved, not an error. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

id.description: An id exactly as returned: verse:<ref>, need:<slug>, church:<uuid>, gathering:<uuid>, community:<uuid>, or lb:<kind>:<slug> (e.g. lb:denomination:methodism).

name: fetch

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

metadata.description: Kind-specific facts plus attribution; unresolved when the id was not found.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

text.description: The item in full as plain text (Scripture verbatim).

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Fetch one search result in full
